title: sse: fix chunking/framing ordering for partial JSON & delimiter edge cases
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Streaming SSE payloads were occasionally emitting delimiter tokens and JSON fragments in an order that caused downstream OpenAI-compatible clients and partial-JSON parsers to see invalid events (partial objects split across events, trailing delimiters appended before final chunk, and cases where function/tool-calling "params" fields were broken). This surfaced in customer-reported incidents (SUP-8890) and in internal perf tests where the OpenAI-compat adapter reassembled chunks incorrectly.

What this PR does: fixes the SSE chunking/framing state machine to guarantee: 1) JSON tokens belonging to the same logical object are emitted in order and not split across event boundaries unless necessary, 2) delimiter ("

" / SSE event boundary) ordering is deterministic and emitted only after the event payload is complete, 3) partial-JSON markers used by our OpenAI-compat adapter are preserved and annotated so client-side partial-JSON parsers can reassemble safely.

Key changes: updated streaming encoder state machine in server/streaming/sse_encoder.go to track "in-object" depth and pending delimiter emission; added a small buffering layer to avoid emitting a delimiter if the next token is still part of the same top-level object; adjusted the OpenAI compatibility adapter at client/compat/openai_streaming_adapter.py to prefer event-boundary-aware reassembly; added unit and integration tests.

Notes on tradeoffs: the buffering window is micro-sized and bounded (configurable, default 8KB/50ms) to avoid tail latency increases while preventing invalid partial JSONs. The change does not alter tokenization or generation ordering; it only affects event framing and emission timing.

Testing: unit tests for encoder state transitions, fuzz tests for split-token edge cases, end-to-end integration tests against the OpenAI-compat adapter and the TypeScript SDK streaming client. CI showed an intermittent lint failure on the first run; fixed by adjusting imports and reformatting.

Related: ENG-4219 added as the main Linear ticket; reference incident SUP-8890.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added for sse_encoder state transitions - [x] Integration test for OpenAI-compat streaming reassembly - [x] Perf/latency check within acceptable bounds (+0.3ms p50) - [x] Added release note

Backwards compatibility: non-breaking for API users; fixes a bug that could surface as malformed events in streaming clients.

review_comments: Lucas Patel (reviewer): The logic looks solid; two requests: add a unit test for the exact case where a '}' is emitted as its own token and ensure we don't emit an event delimiter before the trailing '}' is streamed.
Ava Chen (author): Added the requested test (partial_json.test.ts: closing-brace-split case) and updated the emitter to check 'in-object' depth before delimiter. CI now includes the test.
Maya Singh (reviewer): Please justify the buffering defaults in the PR description and add a config knob for enterprise/private deployments. Also, call out any SLO impacts.

Ava Chen (author): Default is 8KB / 50ms with guardrails in the emitter; added notes in docs/api/streaming.md and an env var STREAM_SSE_BUFFER_MS for Private installs. Performance regression measured: +0.3ms p50, +1.9ms p99 in our synthetic test. No SLO change required but noted in release notes.
Diego Alvarez (approver): Ran perf microbench locally, +0.2ms p50, looks fine. Approved.
CI Bot: Lint failed on first run (unused import), fixed in subsequent commit.
Maya Singh: Approved after tests and docs updates.
release_notes: Fix: streaming SSE framing and chunking to prevent partial-JSON events and delimiter ordering bugs. Improves compatibility with OpenAI-style streaming clients; adds buffering with configurable bounds to avoid malformed events. See docs/api/streaming.md for details.
notes_for_ops: Private installers: STREAM_SSE_BUFFER_MS and STREAM_SSE_BUFFER_BYTES added. Rolling restarts recommended for servers running older emitter logic. No data migration required.
repro_steps: Repro (internal): run tests/streaming/partial_json.fuzz with openai_compat adapter enabled; before fix the adapter would raise a JSON parse error ~1-2% of fuzz runs; after fix parse failure rate ~0%.
